name: Za'tachk — Matriarch

traits.name: Matriarch Caste
traits.description: Matriarchs serve in ruling councils and nest leadership — more intelligent and educated, but with a stronger sense of self-preservation (lower Boldness).

traits.name: Boldness (BOL)
traits.description: Za'tachk have a seventh characteristic, Boldness (BOL), rolled 1D+1 (this caste applies -1 to it). BOL 7+ is seen as recklessly courageous; 10+ is considered insane by other Za'tachk. In any physically dangerous situation a Za'tachk must pass an Average (8+) BOL check to keep acting normally or retreat; failing by Effect -6 or worse causes a brief catatonic state.

traits.name: Brachiator
traits.description: Exemplary climbers who use all limbs as locomotors or manipulators: DM+2 when climbing or swinging, and DM+2 to stabilise on precarious flooring with handholds.

traits.name: Coward
traits.description: Frightened of violence. If threatened within 50 metres a Za'tachk must pass a BOL check or take a defensive measure; even on success they suffer DM-2 to all actions while under the threat.

source: Aliens of Charted Space Vol. 4, Mongoose Publishing
